shared_elements: low-relief carving on an upright monolithic slab/pillar
schematic figural forms rendered in shallow relief
repeated motifs aligned in a row
justification: Both are upright monolithic surfaces bearing shallow, highly schematic relief that includes circular discs and horizontal banding across the shaft, and both share a convention of flat, outlined forms standing slightly proud of a plain ground. But the subject matter differs fundamentally: A is a zoological repertoire (birds, quadrupeds in profile, a row of repeated cap-like signs, feather/plant-like motifs) arranged in registers, whereas B is a single anthropomorphic body with face, nose, folded arms, chest discs and a belt, with no animals at all.
